name: Advisor Sunsworn
summary: Advisor Sunsworn is an enigmatic blood elf envoy stationed at Splintertree Post in the dense woodlands of Ashenvale. Standing among the crude timber fortifications of the Horde outpost, he serves as an observer and advisor in an otherwise strictly orc-dominated territory.

sections.title: A Blood Elf in Ashenvale
sections.body: Amid the rugged palisades and spiked barricades of Splintertree Post, Advisor Sunsworn cuts an unusual figure. Blood elves are rarely seen deep within the ancient forests of Kalimdor, far from the Eastern Kingdoms. Stationed near one of the post's western huts, Sunsworn keeps a quiet vigil over Horde operations in Ashenvale, receiving couriers sent to bolster Splintertree's defenses and lending counsel in a region fraught with night elven resistance.

faq.answer: Advisor Sunsworn is a blood elf stationed at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Rather than an active frontline commander, he acts as an emissary and advisor observing Horde frontier efforts.

faq.q: Where can I find Advisor Sunsworn?
faq.answer: He is located in the western portion of Splintertree Post in central Ashenvale, standing just outside one of the timber huts.

faq.q: What is a blood elf doing at Splintertree Post?
aliases: why is a blood elf in ashenvale
faq.answer: While most forces in Ashenvale are orcs and their close allies, blood elf envoys occasionally travel to distant Horde military outposts to coordinate diplomatic matters, observe regional threats, and receive dispatches from allied commanders.

faq.q: Does Advisor Sunsworn offer any tasks?
faq.answer: He serves as a point of contact for messengers dispatched to the region, receiving reports from those directed to reinforce Splintertree Post.

angles.text: Splintertree Post is a vital foothold against the night elves in Ashenvale, and envoys like Sunsworn help maintain communication and coordination across the Horde's far-flung outposts.
